the ashtray on the bar: cut glass, full of jelly beans
the windows on the left: long, low, smoked; the desert going by
the windows on the right: long, low, smoked; the desert going by
the long seat: gray leather, along the left side; Grandpa Joe sits at its far end
the facing seat: gray leather, along the right side
